pool.text: Don Pedro de Alvarado founded the Spanish town beside the Indian settlement of Choloma.

A Greek Orthodox cathedral, Iglesia Ortodoxa de Antioquía San Juan Bautista, was built.
Roberto Larios Silva stated that economic development is concentrated via industrial, commercial, and financial development.
